headline: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump On Separation Savings View
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper’s updated analyst narrative now centers on a slightly higher fair value estimate, with the assessed price target moving from US$34.24 to US$34.94 per share. Analysts link this modest uplift to expectations around potential cost savings of about US$400 million from the separation, as well as recent index changes and a new national partnership with Dog Haus that broaden the company’s commercial footprint. Read on to see what this means for your view on Keurig Dr Pepper and how...
